Caz & Hex's Potato Soup

.cook
📖 Hex

🥘 Ingredients

  • carrots (sliced)
    2 large
  • celery (sliced)
    2 stalks
  • chicken stock
    3-1/2 cups
  • milk
    1/2 cup
  • minced garlic
    2 tbsp
  • onion (minced)
    1 large
  • parsley
  • pepper
  • potatoes (diced)
    3-4
  • rosemary
  • salt
  • thyme
  • unsalted butter
    4 tbsp

🍳 Cookware

  • large pot
  • immersion blender
  1. 1
    Melt unsalted butter in a large pot , add the onion and minced garlic , then cook over medium heat for ⏱️ 3-4 minutes .
    unsalted butter: 4 tbsp, onion: 1 large (minced), minced garlic: 2 tbsp
  2. 2
    Stir in the potatoes , carrots , and celery , then cover and cook for ⏱️ 5 minutes .
    potatoes: 3-4 (diced), carrots: 2 large (sliced), celery: 2 stalks (sliced)
  3. 3
    Add the chicken stock and season with salt , pepper , rosemary , thyme , and parsley as desired. Bring to a boil then reduce heat, cover and simmer for ⏱️ 30 minutes .
    chicken stock: 3-1/2 cups, salt, pepper, rosemary, thyme, parsley
  4. 4
    Using an immersion blender , blend the contents until mostly smooth.
  5. 5
    Stir in milk and add more seasoning if needed. Return to low heat for a few minutes before serving.
    milk: 1/2 cup
  6. 📝

    Optional additions include pan fried kielbasa or bacon and warm bread.
